facts.name: FieldCommandCtrl_IsSummonGaugeShown_W744_3EC
facts.note: bool(ctrl rcx), return in al: the controller's OWN summon gauge widget (weak ctrl+0x744) byte +0x3EC (gauge shown). 0 for a controller with no widget (every seat's). First term of CanCallSummonForType and of SummonRowState_ForType. The mod's EntryRedirect cannot take it (2-byte first instruction): its call sites below are redirected instead (the controller in rcx; player 2's or 3's -> player 1's). First instruction push rbx (40 53, 2 bytes, no RIP operand); entry %16 = 4 (1.004) / 12 (1.005), inside one block in both. 1.004 bytes 4053b820000000e870994101482be048. Same first 7 bytes as the on-field reader; the call rel32 differs.

facts.name: FieldCommandCtrl_IsSummonOnField_W744_3ED
facts.note: bool(ctrl rcx), return in al: the controller's OWN widget byte +0x3ED (a summon on the field). 0 for a seat's controller. Gates the summon's command row (category 15) and the top-row count. Not entry-redirectable by the mod (2-byte first instruction): its call sites below are redirected instead. Entry %16 = 12 (1.004) / 4 (1.005), first instruction push rbx (2 bytes) inside one block in both. 1.004 bytes 4053b820000000e8a8994101482be048.

facts.name: FieldCommandCtrl_CanCallSummonForType
facts.note: Reference, not redirected: bool(ctrl, u8 type) = IsSummonGaugeShown_W744_3EC(ctrl) && mgr && points% >= 100 && (type == 16 || summon materia equipped) && SummonMgr_CanSummonForType(mgr, type). Enables the Summon row (category 14). First instruction 5 bytes; 1.004 %16 = 12 crosses a block, 1.005 %16 = 12 crosses a block.

facts.name: FieldCommandCtrl_SummonRowState_ForType
facts.note: Reference, not redirected: u8(ctrl, type): 0 unless SummonMgr_CanSummonForType(mgr, type); then 2 if the widget's +0x3EC, else CanCall (0 then). Nonzero = the Summon row is listed (BuildRowCategories, UpdateRowCount).

facts.name: SummonMgr_CanSummonForType
facts.note: Reference: bool(mgr, type); global and per-type terms only, no controller or leader read. Also re-tested by FieldCommandCtrl_TryExecuteQueuedCommand for category 14 (1.004 0x140FA9790).

facts.name: g_SummonMgr_BC60 (the summon manager pointer)
facts.note: Loaded with mov (a pointer); the first argument of SummonMgr_CanSummonForType.

facts.name: g_SummonGaugeShownLatch
facts.note: u8: the game's own record of 'gauge shown'; written by SummonGauge_Show/Hide_LatchToEUI23 (1.004 0x1414E8DE8/0x1414E869C, 1.005 0x141792E38/0x14096A450), which then copy it into EndUISystem[23]'s +0x755 and widget +0x3EC. For logging beside the redirect.

facts.name: g_SummonOnFieldLatch
facts.note: u8: the game's own record of 'summon on the field'; written by SummonOnField_Set/Clear_LatchToEUI23 (1.004 0x1414E9300/0x1414E85F4, 1.005 0x140837870/0x14096A3F0) -> EndUISystem[23]'s +0x756 and widget +0x3ED.

facts.name: call: CanCallSummonForType -> IsSummonGaugeShown_W744_3EC
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e88ed23000, 1.005 e8266936ff). Caller FieldCommandCtrl_CanCallSummonForType (1.004 0x14098830C, 1.005 0x1417A278C); rcx = the caller's own ctrl argument, unchanged. Decides the summon-ready test, term 1: the Summon row's enable (CmdState2_UpdateRowEnabled), the list widget, the summon icon state.

facts.name: call: SummonRowState_ForType -> IsSummonGaugeShown_W744_3EC
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e88521f7ff, 1.005 e8e22b93ff). Caller FieldCommandCtrl_SummonRowState_ForType (1.004 0x140D233EC, 1.005 0x1411D64B4); rcx = rbx = its ctrl argument. Decides whether the Summon row (category 14) is listed (value 2).

facts.name: call: EndUI_IsSummonGaugeShownOrOnField_EUI23 -> IsSummonGaugeShown_W744_3EC
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e85e000000, 1.005 e85e000000). Caller EndUI_IsSummonGaugeShownOrOnField_EUI23 (1.004 0x140C95534, 1.005 0x140B0904C); rcx = rdi = EndUISystem[23] read at the call. The battle-log helper: lifts the log queue 40 units while the gauge is shown. Not part of the Summon decision; redirect only for consistency.

facts.name: call: EndUI_IsSummonGaugeShownOrOnField_EUI23 -> IsSummonOnField_W744_3ED
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e818000000, 1.005 e818000000). Same caller and role as the entry above (the battle-log helper), its second term.

facts.name: call: CmdState2_UpdateRowCount -> IsSummonOnField_W744_3ED
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e86523f7ff, 1.005 e8d12a93ff). Caller CmdState2_UpdateRowCount (1.004 0x140D23168, 1.005 0x1411D6514, size 0x100 both); rcx = [rdi+18h], the state's ctrl. The top menu's row count: one row fewer unless RowState or on-field; a changed count rebuilds the rows.

facts.name: call: CmdState2_Vt68_CellSetup_TopRows -> IsSummonOnField_W744_3ED
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e8c6b8c0ff, 1.005 e8de7095ff). Caller CmdState2_Vt68_CellSetup_TopRows (1.004 0x14108923C, 1.005 0x1411B153C, size 0x10D1 both, vtable slot both); rcx = [r14+18h], the state's ctrl. The top rows' cell setup: the summon row's cell when a summon is on the field.

facts.name: call: CmdState2_BuildRowCategories -> IsSummonOnField_W744_3ED
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e8e48a63ff, 1.005 e81c843aff). Caller CmdState2_BuildRowCategories (1.004 0x14165C98C, 1.005 0x141760B6C, size 0x1C0 both); rcx = [rbp+18h], the state's ctrl. The row builder: category 15 (the summon's commands) when on the field, else 14 (Summon) when RowState.

facts.name: call: MemberSelecter_TickSummonIconState_cand -> IsSummonOnField_W744_3ED
facts.note: Direct E8 (1.004 e871583aff, 1.005 e8c0b42700). Caller MemberSelecter_TickSummonIconState_cand (1.004 0x1418EFB98, 1.005 0x14088DA48; from MemberSelecter_TickF0); rcx = rbp = the selecter's ctrl (+0x18). The other menu function: the summon icon/guide state (1 = summon usable: on the field or CanCall; 4 in rows 14/15; else 3).
